title: Very thin
text: Very thin. I purchased these to make Halloween bags for the kids. They worked but we’re very thin. (Like very low thread count and could see between the threads.) I didn’t have high expectations with the price, but was a little surprised by how thin. I will say they worked and no one said it fell apart.
